summary: Optimi Health Corp., a Vancouver-based Nasdaq/CSE-listed pharmaceutical manufacturer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 7, 2026, announcing participation in the ThinkEquity Conference on October 15, 2026, at the Mandarin Oriental Hotel in New York City. Management will present a corporate overview at 4:00 p.m. Eastern and hold one-on-one investor meetings. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine investor-conference notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or arbitrage angle apply.
